A '''sardonyx crystal''' was a rare kind of [[tasar crystal]] that had the ability to turn an individual [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and to imbue them with a specific [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] after several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of attunement. The sardonyx crystal was red and white in color, and had the ability to grant an individual the power of [[Accelerate Healing|Accelerate Another's Healing]].<ref name="J15" />
